description: This file contains utility functions for analyzing and grouping code blocks within a Python file, specifically for identifying classes and functions, and assigning hierarchical names.

methods.name: list[Block] blocks(pf: PythonFile)
methods.description: Analyzes a PythonFile object to identify code blocks such as classes and functions, establishing parent-child relationships.

methods.name: None _add_full_names( blocks: Sequence[Block], children: Sequence[Block], prefix: str = "" )
methods.description: Recursively assigns full hierarchical names to blocks, handling duplicate names at any level.

methods.name: Block _make_block(pf: PythonFile, begin: int)
methods.description: Constructs a Block object from tokens in a PythonFile, identifying its type, name, docstring, and extent.

ctags.name: _add_full_names
ctags.signature: ( blocks: Sequence[Block], children: Sequence[Block], prefix: str = "" )
